title: Chapter 459 Ragnarok
content:
Chapter 459 Ragnarok

"Take action quickly, otherwise the consequences will be unimaginable!"

After the people of Huangcheng reacted, the offensive became even more fierce, but after the sacrifice, the gods were extremely terrifying and were no longer able to deal with the powerful people in Huangcheng fighting alone.

Then, the strong men in the desert began to choose to siege these six gods.

Because they found that the other powerful people in the land of Gods were afraid of death, and they chose to commit suicide, crashing into the giant pillar of the sky, contributing to their master.

But in a short period of time, it seemed that only these six gods were left in the land of the gods.

But this did not make everyone happy, because what they received was the terrifying strength of these six gods.

"And also want to kill the gods?"

"Since you dare to offend us, keep your life!"

The gods laughed hideously, and actually suppressed the people in the deserted city.

Lu Xue wandered behind everyone, her face solemn.

In this way, she had no effect after coming here. She was not a match for the gods.

but.

Lu Xue's eyes were placed on the six giant pillars that reached the sky in the center of the land of the gods.

At this moment, these six pillars still exude a striking light and brew powerful power.

"I understand. The so-called gods only have such terrifying strength through these six pillars. If these six pillars are destroyed, then Master and the others can deal with the gods."

Afterwards, Lu Xue quickly sent a message to everyone in secret.

"Kill those pillars and these gods will no longer be a threat."

When everyone heard this, they all divided part of their attention to the pillar and immediately understood.

Yun Qi immediately ordered his subordinates to attack the pillar, form a battle formation, and sternly kill the pillar.

However, when the army approached the giant pillar to the sky, an invisible willpower suddenly came, which made the army begin to be confused and feel like they wanted to devote their lives to the pillar.

Feeling this, Yun Qi was shocked and hurriedly used his means to force the Lu family army to restore some of their minds and rescue the Lu family army.

"It seems that without enough strength, I can't get close to those pillars at all."

Yun Qi said secretly.

Lu Xue's face was solemn, watching as most of the strong men in the Huangcheng City had been involved in the battle.

The gods also seemed to have noticed their intentions and deliberately or unintentionally pulled the strong into the battlefield and were not allowed to escape.

Lu Xue had no choice but to go into battle himself.

"My master, be careful, don't be affected by that pillar."

Ao Qing was a little worried and followed Lu Xue carefully.

Lu Xue smiled and said, "I have Xuanyuan Sword in my hand, how can I influence me just the will of a pseudo-god?"

Seeing that Lu Xue was so confident, Ao Qing stopped talking.

And at this moment, a figure appeared behind Lu Xue one after another.

"Senior Lu Xue, we will also help you!"

Feeling the breath behind him, Lu Xue was slightly shocked and quickly looked back.

"It's you, you're going to retreat, this giant pillar is extraordinary."

The person behind him was the strong man brought by Lu Xue from the Chaos Realm.

I originally thought of coming here to pick up the bargains and killing some creatures from the land of the gods, but I didn't expect that this would happen after I came here.

Everyone smiled bitterly when they heard Lu Xue's words.

"Senior Lu Xue, we have nothing else to do, so we can't let us watch it."

Although they are all top-notch players in the Chaos Realm, they can't even intervene here.

I'm afraid that any aftermath of the battle is not something they can handle.

Seeing Lu Xue doing such a dangerous thing, they naturally would not sit idly by.

At this moment, they have put life and death aside.

Looking at everyone's determination to die, Lu Xue's face was complicated.

"Well, let's go together."

"Follow me!"

Lu Xue opened the way with the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand and approached the giant pillar to the sky. Suddenly, a powerful will suddenly descended, making everyone feel dazed.

At this moment, the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand burst out with light, which actually repelled this will.

Lu Xue seemed to be fine and looked very happy.

However, except for Lu Xue, everyone else was not so lucky.

Some of the slightly weaker ones can no longer hold on and take the initiative to approach the giant pillar and contribute their lives.

Lu Xue was shocked and looked at Ao Qing on the side.

I saw that Ao Qing was also affected a little, but he was retreating slightly and was unwilling to devote his life.

It is worthy of being Ao Qing, and even God cannot shake his spirit of cherishing life.

Then Lu Xue slapped Ao Qing's head with a sword.

Ao Qing suddenly woke up.

"Little Master!"

Seeing Ao Qing recovering, Lu Xue let out a light breath, and then slashed out with a sword.

The sword light accurately cut through everyone present, and a slight wound was cut, but at the same time, everyone's mind suddenly recovered from awakening.

"Do this pillar first!"

Lu Xue pointed at the giant pillar that reached the sky in front of her and roared.

Immediately afterwards, everyone used all their strength to attack the pillar wildly.

The attack fell on the pillar, but there was no reaction at all, and at most it only left a trace.

Everyone looked ugly.

They never thought they would be so useless.

Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword in his hand but cut the giant pillar out of a crack with one sword, and Lu Xue was immediately overjoyed.

At the same time, a god on the battlefield was shocked and his spiritual sense swept towards Lu Xue and others.

"Humble ants, you are looking for death!"

However, he was about to set off, but he was tightly held back by the strong men in Huangcheng.

"Miss Lu Xue, let's block it for you!"

Lu Xue nodded heavily and no longer cared about behind her.

After looking at the lost look, Lu Xue waved her hand, "Today I will let you experience the feeling of krypton gold!"

Balls of light flew out and fell in front of everyone.

It is a series of amazing magical weapons, only a little heard in the legend.

Now, it appears before them.

"This, this, this, is this the legendary God-killing Halberd!"

The head of the Tian Yao Clan looked at the divine weapon in front of him and grabbed it in his hand with an extremely excited expression.

The rest of the people also grabbed the weapons in front of them and couldn't let go of them.

With the divine weapon in hand, they are no longer powerless to the divine pillar in front of them.

Boom boom boom boom!

The colorful offensive rushed towards the divine pillar, which immediately made the divine pillar shaky and constantly collapsed.

"No!!"

In the distance, the god's eyes were so angry that he was extremely unwilling to accept it.

At this moment, he burst out with unprecedented strength, but was stopped by the strong men in Huangcheng without giving in.

In the end, with the efforts of Lu Xue and others, this giant pillar that reaches the sky finally collapsed completely.

Rumble!

The entire land of the gods was shocked.

The gods looked shocked.

But everyone in Huangcheng looked overjoyed.

After a brief roar, the god suddenly became depressed as if he was deflated.

"die!"

Yun Qi waved his sword and immediately turned his body and head away.
